name: MIT Indoor 67
description: Indoor scene classification dataset with 67 categories and about 15.6k images, using an 80/20 per-class train/test split. The dataset is subject to MIT release terms; no data is vendored here.
citation: MIT Indoor 67: Quattoni, A., & Torralba, A. (2009). Recognizing indoor scenes. IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
